title: 15 Mistakes First-Timers Make in China (Do NOT Skip #3) | China Travel Expert
description:
Planning your first trip to China in 2026? These are the 15 mistakes first-time visitors make again and again — and exactly how to sidestep each one, from payment apps and the Great Firewall to passports, Golden Week crowds, and the one habit that quietly ruins a rushed itinerary. Everything here is current as of September 2026.

10:24 Outro

Quick reference: Beijing–Shanghai high-speed rail is ~4h18m, second-class roughly ¥300–650 (about $25–$100), book on Trip.com/Klook or the official 12306. Forbidden City admission ¥60 high season (~$8.50), online booking only and it sells out in minutes. Golden Week is October 1–7. Tap water should be boiled (hotels provide a kettle). Tipping is generally not customary. Prices are approximate for 2026 — always verify before you book, and confirm visa/entry rules with your nearest Chinese embassy and the National Immigration Administration.

🧭 Expert Tip: Build your offline kit before you land — offline translator, offline map, hotel address screenshotted in Chinese, and an eSIM — so your first hour in China is the easy part.
